_about: Module status register. Each status must match the definition on the website status page. Tests are path prefixes of the test files that prove the module; the status report counts their results from the CI run. Change a status only when the evidence changes.

definitions.AVAILABLE: Production-ready, tested, supported and commercially deployable.
definitions.EARLY_ACCESS: Functional and suitable for controlled customer onboarding.

modules.name: General ledger
modules.summary: Accounts, monthly periods, balanced multi-currency entries, reversals and the trial balance.

modules.name: Sales and invoicing
modules.summary: Invoices, payments, credit notes, quotes and voiding, posted to the ledger. The screens are not built yet.

modules.name: Party master (customers and suppliers)
modules.summary: Customers, suppliers and both, with tax ID checks. Merge and de-duplication are not built.

modules.name: Item master
modules.summary: Item codes and units. Variants, barcodes and price lists are not built.

modules.name: Approval queue
modules.summary: Requests with a reason, decisions by a second person, withdrawal. Chains and thresholds are not built.

modules.name: Tamper-evident audit trail
modules.summary: Every change is chained to the one before, so an edited or removed record is detected. The viewer screen is not built.

modules.name: Identity and sessions
modules.summary: Password sign-in and sessions. Single sign-on and two-factor sign-in are not built.

modules.name: Tenancy and row-level security
modules.summary: Each business is kept separate by database rules, checked by tests on every table.

modules.name: Website enquiries
modules.summary: Demo and trial requests are stored with consent. Email alerts depend on the operator's webhook.

modules.name: Trace a number
modules.summary: From an invoice, the ledger entries behind every figure, with account names. The screen is not built yet.

modules.name: Purchasing
modules.summary: Requests, purchase orders, goods receipts and supplier bills matched to both.

modules.name: Inventory with batch expiry
modules.summary: Stock by batch with expiry dates: receipts, issues that take the batch expiring first, write-off of expired stock, a pharmacy expiry report with the value at risk, all posted to the ledger. Stock counts, transfers, import and the screens are not built yet.

modules.name: Payroll and HR
modules.summary: Attendance, leave and payslips, with rules set for each country.

modules.name: Point of sale with offline sync
modules.summary: Sales with split payments and change, stock taken first to expire first, posted to the ledger. Sales synced from a device once are never posted twice, and sales that cannot be posted are kept for review. Card and mobile connectors, returns, shifts and the till screen are not built yet.

modules.name: AI bots
modules.summary: Routine work drafted by bots. Each action waits for approval in the queue; no bot is built yet.
